description: This file is a Node.js script for profiling memory usage (peak RSS) of extensions in a project. It imports Node.js modules for process control and file system operations, and defines functions to parse command-line arguments, run memory profiling cases, and generate reports. The script is intended to be executed from the command line to measure memory consumption of specific extension build outputs or the entire set of extensions.

methods.name: printHelp
methods.description: Displays usage information and options for the profiling script.

methods.name: parsePositiveInt
methods.description: Parses and validates a positive integer from a raw string input.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to configure the profiling run.

methods.name: parseMaxRssMb
methods.description: Extracts the maximum RSS value in MB from stderr output.

methods.name: summarizeStderr
methods.description: Returns a summarized version of the first few lines of stderr output.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Runs a child process to execute a profiling test case and collects its performance metrics.

methods.name: buildImportBody
methods.description: Builds JavaScript code that imports specified extension files for profiling.

methods.name: findExtensionEntries
methods.description: Locates built extension entrypoints in the project's distribution directory.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Coordinates the overall profiling process, including baseline measurement, extension profiling, and report generation.
